identitySignals: Name matches a registered California general corporation: 'Syntex Global, Inc.' in Berkeley, CA (business filing summary of California Secretary of State record), matching the agenda's 'Syntex Global, Inc.' and 'Berkeley, CA'
Company's own website describes translation, interpreting and localization services, matching OUSD's Office of Equity contract under RFP #22-139OE 'Translation and Interpretation Services'
research.notes: Entity number and mailing address come from a third-party aggregator of California Secretary of State filings (bizprofile.net), not the Secretary of State site directly. profile.summary: A for-profit language services company based in Berkeley, California. It provides translation, interpreting, bilingual staffing, cultural training and website localization in more than 100 languages.

sources.title: Syntex Global, Inc. Berkeley, CA - filing information

review.notes: Syntex Global, Inc. is a Berkeley, CA general corporation (entity 4084182) offering translation/interpreting services, which fits OUSD's RFP 22-139OE contract and the agenda's Berkeley location. The street address listed in the filing (2000 Allston Way) and the contact page (Berkeley, CA 94701-0245 only) do not show the 'PO Box 245' address, so address is unsupported.
